title: Insights into the structure and evolution of the human SAGA complex by affinity-ligand purification.
authors: Damilot, Mylene; Schoeps, Thomas; Tora, Laszlo; Schultz, Patrick; Lebeau, Luc; Papai, Gabor; Ben-Shem, Adam
one_liner_zh: 该文通过亲和配体纯化解析人SAGA共激活复合物的结构，聚焦蛋白复合物组装与进化，未涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: Human SAGA is a 20-subunit transcriptional coactivator. Compared with yeast, metazoan SAGA uniquely incorporates a 150-kDa splicing-factor module (SPL), also present in U2 small nuclear ribonucleoprotein (U2snRNP). Metazoan gene duplication further specialized shared TFIID/SAGA subunits into SAGA-specific paralogs (TAF5L and TAF6L), but the functional consequences of this divergence are unknown. We report the structure of endogenous human SAGA purified via an affinity ligand from cells that were not disturbed by any genomic engineering tools. Our work reveals the high-resolution structure of SPL and the TAF6L HEAT repeat domain that provides the SPL with a docking surface. We elucidate how SPL and the HEAT repeats are incorporated into SAGA. We identify major structural differences between TAF6L/TAF5L and their canonical paralogs that enable SPL accommodation. SPL engages SAGA through a substantially smaller interface than in U2snRNP, despite sharing a deeply inserted helical motif. The seemingly weaker interaction of SPL with SAGA raises the possibility that SAGA relays this module to the splicing machinery.
abstract_zh: 人源SAGA是一个由20个亚基组成的转录共激活因子。与酵母相比，后生动物SAGA独特地整合了一个150-kDa的剪接因子模块（SPL），该模块也存在于U2小核核糖核蛋白（U2snRNP）中。后生动物的基因复制进一步将共享的TFIID/SAGA亚基特化为SAGA特异性的旁系同源物（TAF5L和TAF6L），但这种分化的功能后果尚不清楚。我们报道了通过亲和配体从未经任何基因组工程工具干扰的细胞中纯化的内源性人源SAGA的结构。我们的工作揭示了SPL和TAF6L HEAT重复域的高分辨率结构，该域为SPL提供了对接表面。我们阐明了SPL和HEAT重复如何整合到SAGA中。我们识别了TAF6L/TAF5L与其典型旁系同源物之间的主要结构差异，这些差异使得SPL得以容纳。尽管共享一个深度插入的螺旋基序，SPL通过一个比在U2snRNP中显著更小的界面与SAGA结合。SPL与SAGA之间看似较弱的相互作用提出了SAGA可能将该模块传递给剪接机制的可能性。
